snippet.title: Holiday Decorator Annoucement Trailer
snippet.description: Decorate the Christmas trees of your dreams in your own cozy little shop. Listen to each customer’s wish, choose from hundreds of decorations and send them home with a tree made just for them, while a curious kitten watches you work.
